description: Search CarRentalList's exotic car news (new models, rental market stories, events), newest first, by words in the headline, excerpt and keywords and/or by make. Use this when someone asks for news about a car, a make or an event (Monterey Car Week, a new Ferrari), or what is new in the exotic car world; then call get_news_article with a slug for the full text. Without query and make: the latest articles. When no article has every word, articles with any of them are returned (match = any).

make.description: only articles about this make (Ferrari, Lamborghini, Rolls-Royce)

query.description: words to look for in the headline, excerpt and keywords ('Monterey Car Week', 'McLaren W1')

name: search_news

as_of.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the catalog's last content change

source_url.description: the original story the article is based on

match.description: all = every query word matched; any = no article had them all, so articles with at least one; none = no query

title: Search exotic car news
